# 20. Three Teachings Grand Debate
oe_rel.20 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_rel.20.t
	desc = oe_rel.20.desc
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_yuan_court_envoy.dds"
	outcome = positive

	option = {
		name = oe_rel.20.a
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_rel_debate_confucian_court
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modifier:allow_righteousness = yes }
			add_righteousness = righteousness_mild_bonus
		}
		random_international_organizations_member_of = {
			limit = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:sect
				OR = {
					var:religion ?= religion:sanjiao
					var:religion ?= religion:mahayana
				}
			}
			add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_rel_neo_confucian_ritual
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_rel.20.b
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_rel_debate_daoist_court
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modifier:allow_harmony = yes }
			add_harmony = 10
		}
		random_international_organizations_member_of = {
			limit = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:sect
				OR = {
					var:religion ?= religion:sanjiao
					var:religion ?= religion:mahayana
				}
			}
			add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_rel_quanzhen_harmony
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_rel.20.c
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_rel_debate_buddhist_court
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { religion = { has_karma = yes } }
			add_karma = karma_mild_bonus
		}
		random_international_organizations_member_of = {
			limit = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:sect
				OR = {
					var:religion ?= religion:sanjiao

# 21. Imperial Preceptor Empowerment
oe_rel.21 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_rel.21.t
	desc = oe_rel.21.desc
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_yuan_court_envoy.dds"
	outcome = positive

	option = {
		name = oe_rel.21.a
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_rel_preceptor_blessing
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		every_subject = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism
					religion = religion:tengri
				}
			}
			add_opinion = {
				target = root
				modifier = opinion_pleased
			}
		}
		random_international_organizations_member_of = {
			limit = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:sect
				OR = {
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:vajrayana_policy
					var:religion ?= religion:tibetan_buddhism
				}
			}
			add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_rel_sakya_imperial_preceptor

			limit = {

					international_organization_has_policy = policy:vajrayana_policy

				}
			}
			add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_rel_gelug_monastic_discipline
		}
	}
